description: Keep the chunk loaded while you’re logged out using a craftable item in Survival.

mods.name: Force Chunk Loading
mods.description: A server-authoritative, craftable configurable-texture player head that keeps its chunk loaded.

releases.notes:
## What's changed

- Fixed the C2ME world-load deadlock by deferring marker scans and using non-blocking forced-chunk ticket updates.
- Removed the mod's forced-chunk tickets during server shutdown.
- Prevented placing more than one loader marker in the same chunk.
- Added operator commands: `/chunkloader status`, `list`, `orphans`/`check`, `remove`, and `reload`.
- Failed config reloads keep the previously active configuration.

## Compatibility

- Minecraft 26.2
- Fabric Loader 0.19.3+
- Java 25+
- Server-side only; clients do not need the mod.
